messages:
Nora: Quick sync — propose a 2-week micro-webinar + pricing FAQ refresh sprint. Goal: improve conversions on the packages page, test new slab names, and add a guided calculator. Thoughts?

Devon: Love it. Can we gate the calculator for 'demo' leads only the first week and measure lift?

Rana: Agree on the gating. Also want a short benchmark narrative in the webinar: compare per-1k-token cost across setups + Redwood Optimize improvements. I'll draft slides.

Sam: I can update the FAQ microcopy and spin up the launch post. Need final tier names by EOD Wed to lock hero variants.

Alina: SalesOps request: clear routing for calc submits — high intent -> SDR queue, medium -> nurture flow, low -> automated guide email. Can we add lead_score mapping?

Nora: Yes. Proposed routing rules below — feedback?

```yaml
# proposed routing
event: pricing_calc_submitted
fields: [calc_result, lead_score, company_size]
rules:
  - if: lead_score >= 70
    action: assign -> sdr_pricing_fastlane
  - if: lead_score >= 40
    action: notify -> growth-nurture
  - else
    action: auto_email -> pricing-guide
```

ops-bot: analytics: pricing_calc_submitted fired 42 times in last 24h (staging).

Devon: For tier names — shortlist A: Starter / Scale / Enterprise; shortlist B: Developer / Business / Dedicated. I mildly prefer A but we'll test.

Rana: Let's run an A/B microtest on the hero + calculator CTA. 50/50 traffic for 2 weeks, then check conversion + lead quality.

Sam: I'll prepare two hero lines and CTA copy. Webinar blurb draft: 'Reduce inference costs by 3x with Redwood Optimize' — ok to use that claim?

Nora: :thumbsup: Good. Schedule micro-webinar Wed 3/18 10am PT. Keep it short (30m) with a 10-min live demo using the calculator.

Alina: SalesOps will implement HubSpot routing. Need final field mapping by Friday so we can test.

Nora: Action items — @Sam final copy Wed EOD, @Rana AB test config Thurs, @Alina HubSpot mapping Fri, @Devon funnel metrics setup. I'll create the doc and invite: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EXAMPLE (working draft).

Devon: One more metric ask — track events 'pricing_faq_cta_click' and 'calculator_start' and pipe to the funnel dashboard.

ops-bot: Reminder: add event tags -> source=webinar and experiment=slab-names-v1 when firing events.

Rana: Quick legal check — can we say '3x' in marketing materials? @legal?

Sam: I'll ping legal and summarize requirements here.

Nora: Cool. I'll create the calendar invite and post a reminder 24h before. :calendar: Thanks all — we'll circle back after initial data.
